messages:
mohit: Heads up — PR #10458 (service-shim) is green locally but CI has been flaky. APAC deploy freeze starts 2026-03-20 00:00 UTC. Can we hold merges into main for ~12h around that window for safety? Need an explicit hold on this PR until we have a clean CI + canary. @sylvia @zach @anya

sylvia: I can gate this PR. Suggest we wait for one successful full CI run + canary. The failing test earlier was `integration::kv-evict`, looks timing-sensitive.

zach: SRE preference is to avoid merges during the freeze unless tiny and well-tested. If this change is low-risk we can do a canary on dedicated to validate. @release-bot can you schedule a canary job for #10458?

release-bot: release-bot: Canary job for PR #10458 scheduled on dedicated pool — queued.

anya: I can dig into the flaky failure, ETA ~1.5h. If it's the timing flake we can either mute or tighten the assertion. Also you can run `gh pr checks --watch` locally and rebase with main to pick up infra fixes.

mohit: Thanks @anya. If rebase is needed do `git pull --rebase origin main` then `git push --force-with-lease`. I'll hold my approval until we have a green E2E run and canary.

leo: If you need a manual merge/rollback window, I can standby to coordinate. Ping me if you want me on call during merge.

sylvia: Agreed on 1 successful full CI + canary. Also please add a visible label like `hold/deploy-freeze` so it's obvious in the queue.

mohit: Added label `hold/deploy-freeze` and left a comment on the PR. @release-bot any ETA on the canary start?

release-bot: release-bot: Canary job started — build 7825 running (dedicated pool). Will post status updates.

zach: If the build passes, hold off on merging until canary completes green. Filed ops ticket to lock autoscale during freeze: OPS-439.

anya: Build passed! Logs indicate the timing flake was mitigated by infra cut. I left a tiny test tweak MR in the PR (one-line). Can I get a quick review from @sylvia?

sylvia: Looked through the tweak, LGTM. Remove the `hold/deploy-freeze` label when the canary finishes green.

mohit: Canary is green per release-bot. Removing `hold/deploy-freeze` and will merge after a short 15m quiet window to avoid race with other merges. Thanks all :tada:
